title: TOEIC Listening & Reading Full Test 19
description: Đề thi đầy đủ theo cấu trúc đề TOEIC Listening & Reading của IIG Việt Nam: 200 câu, 120 phút (Listening ~45 phút audio chạy liên tục, Reading 75 phút). Chủ đề: bảo hành ống kính, video kỷ niệm công ty, bánh mì không gluten, xe giao hàng hỏng, sữa yến mạch, sân thượng chung cư, cắt giảm ngân sách quảng cáo, Wi-Fi khách sạn, giáo trình, giao hàng hoả tốc, phòng khám thú y, lớp đạp xe, giao hàng bằng drone, làm việc từ xa, cách nhiệt nhà, khởi công thư viện, công suất khách sạn, rửa xe lưu động, bảo mật tài khoản, hiệu sách có quán cà phê, chương trình cố vấn, ứng dụng chống lãng phí thức ăn, máy lọc không khí, thiết kế web, lịch xe buýt, chuyển nhà, thử thách đọc sách hè; đủ dạng hội thoại 3 người, câu hỏi hàm ý, biểu đồ, chèn câu, đoạn kép và ba đoạn. Mỗi câu có giải thích tiếng Việt.

Metro Transit – Route 12 Schedule Change

Beginning October 6, Route 12 buses will run every 20 minutes instead of every 15 minutes on weekdays between 9 A.M. and 4 P.M. Rush-hour service (6–9 A.M. and 4–7 P.M.) will not change. Weekend service will increase from every 30 minutes to every 20 minutes.

The change is based on passenger surveys showing low ridership during midday hours and higher demand on weekends.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: feedback@metrotransit.org
From: George Mills
Date: October 10
Subject: Route 12

Hello,

I ride Route 12 every weekday to my job at Lakeside Hospital, where I work a shift from 11 A.M. to 7 P.M. Since the schedule change, I have had to wait longer for the bus in the morning, and I was late for work twice this week.

Many hospital employees start their shifts at 11. Would it be possible to add an extra bus around 10:30 A.M.?

Thank you,
George Mills

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: George Mills
From: Metro Transit Customer Relations
Date: October 14
Subject: RE: Route 12

Dear Mr. Mills,

Thank you for your feedback. After receiving similar comments from other riders, we have decided to add an extra Route 12 bus that will depart from Central Station at 10:25 A.M. on weekdays, beginning October 20. This bus will stop at Lakeside Hospital at approximately 10:45 A.M.

We appreciate your help in improving our service.

Metro Transit Customer Relations

Swift Movers – Moving Estimate
Customer: Karen Holt
Moving date: Saturday, May 24
From: 45 Pine Street, Apt. 3C (third floor, no elevator)
To: 12 River Road (house)

Three movers and one truck (estimated 5 hours × $120 per hour) • $600
Stair fee (third floor, no elevator) • $75
Packing materials • $90
Estimated total • $765

The final price will be based on the actual hours worked. Items requiring special handling, such as pianos, must be listed in advance.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: bookings@swiftmovers.com
From: Karen Holt
Date: May 12
Subject: Moving estimate

Hello,

Thank you for the estimate. I'd like to confirm the booking for May 24. I forgot to mention that I have an upright piano. Please let me know how much it will cost to move it.

Also, I will pack everything myself, so I won't need the packing materials.

Thank you,
Karen Holt

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: Karen Holt
From: Swift Movers
Date: May 13
Subject: RE: Moving estimate

Dear Ms. Holt,

Your move is confirmed for May 24. Moving an upright piano costs an additional $150, and we will send a fourth mover to help carry it safely down the stairs. The extra mover will not increase the hourly rate.

We have removed the packing materials from your estimate. Our team will arrive at 8:00 A.M.

Swift Movers

Summer Reading Challenge – Oakdale Public Library
June 16 – August 15

Children ages 5 to 12 are invited to read as many books as they can this summer! Participants record the books they read in a reading log.

Prizes:
• 10 books: a free bookmark and pencil set
• 20 books: a ticket to the Oakdale Children's Museum
• 30 books: a $25 gift card to Page One Bookstore

All participants who read at least 10 books are invited to an end-of-summer party on August 22. Register at any library branch or online.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Summer Reading Challenge – Registration
Child's name: Lucas Brown
Age: 9
Parent/guardian: Emily Brown
Library branch: Westside
Date registered: June 18

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: Emily Brown
From: Oakdale Public Library
Date: August 16
Subject: Summer Reading Challenge

Dear Ms. Brown,

Congratulations! According to his reading log, Lucas read 24 books this summer. He can pick up his prize at the Westside branch any time this week.

We also hope to see you at our end-of-summer party. Please note that the party has been moved to the main library downtown because of the large number of participants.

Oakdale Public Library
